name: Graphics
summary: Drawing the world in 3D: the track and terrain, trackside (trees, grandstands, pits), the Blender-built car models with liveries, sun, sky, weather and the camera.
notes: Only reads state, never changes the race. Cars: tools/build_cars.py (Blender) turns tools/car_shapes/<id>.json + the cars module dimensions into cars/<id>.glb (and cars_blend/<id>.blend to edit). See docs/GRAPHICS.md. Liveries carry sponsor stickers and door numbers (invented sponsors, textures/decals.png from tools/build_decals.py; slots per car in data/liveries.json; CarView.sponsors lists them). Prototype shapes: prototype, fin, flap wings, single-mount wings, louvres.
